mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 30 degrees with overcast skies at Verona City Hall. We have a beautiful Full Moon tonight, and although the International Space Station passes overhead, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

City residents should look for property tax bills in the mail by December 15. You can pay your taxes in two installments online, by mail, or at the 24/7 drop boxes located in the City Center parking lot and main entrance.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, you can catch live music at Paddy Mac's, enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness, or grab pizza at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to Trivia Night at the Bogey Factory, ART House 360 Thursday nights, and Hop Haus Trivia.
In a report regarding notable calls from earlier this month, on November 2, a 48-year-old man was arrested following a domestic disturbance call on West End Circle.
If you are craving something sweet, today's flavor is Dark Chocolate Decadence. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM and will be ready to serve you until 10:00 PM.
